start.text: *1:04 a.m. Her phone lights up the ceiling. Ploy.*

call_2.speaker: Ploy
call_2.text: [whiny] [dramatic] "He left me on read, Elysia. For three hours. And then he sent a meme."

call_3.text: *Elysia lies in the dark with the phone on the pillow next to her ear. Her eyes are closed.*

call_4.speaker: Elysia
call_4.text: [tired] [to herself] History presentation tomorrow. No, today. And it's Monday. Kay always gets pad kra pao on Mondays.

call_6.text: *She says it because it is, and because Ploy needs her to.*

call_7.speaker: Ploy
call_7.text: [excited] [rapid] "Right?? Okay, so here's what he said, I'll read you the whole thing—"

choices.text: "Ploy, I'm so sorry, I have to sleep. Tomorrow at lunch?"

call_stay_1.text: *She stays on until 3:07 a.m. Ploy feels better by the end. Elysia can hear it.*

call_stay_2.speaker: Elysia
call_stay_2.text: [tired] [convincing herself] Good. That's good. That's what I'm for.

call_sleep_2.speaker: Ploy
call_sleep_2.text: [hurt] [quietly] "...Oh. Yeah. Sure. Sorry for bothering you."

call_sleep_3.speaker: Elysia
call_sleep_3.real_text: "You're not bothering me, I'm just so tired—"

call_sleep_5.text: *Click. Elysia lies awake until two anyway, replaying "sorry for bothering you" until it stops sounding like words.*

bfast_1.text: *At breakfast, Pun is eating eggs with one hand and holding a jar with the other.*

bfast_2.speaker: Pun
bfast_2.text: [excited] [shouting] "Look. LOOK. I found him by the drain."

bfast_3.text: *Inside the jar is a twig with something bright yellow spread across it. Like spilled egg yolk, branching into veins like a tiny map.*

bfast_4.text: *Elysia knows exactly what it is. She knows the Latin name. She knows it isn't mold at all. Not a plant. Not an animal.*

bfast_5.text: *In third grade she'd have been on the floor next to Pun, nose against the glass.*

choices.text: "That's a slime mold! It's not even mold, it's—"

bfast_just_1.text: *Pun's face falls, just a little. He puts the jar next to his plate and eats his eggs.*

bfast_just_2.text: *Elysia doesn't look at the jar again. It's hard.*

bfast_rhino_1.text: *It comes out before she can check.*

bfast_rhino_3.speaker: Elysia
bfast_rhino_3.text: "[hesitates] I just... [quickly] read about it once. [bossy] Eat your eggs. You'll be late."

bfast_rhino_4.text: *But Pun keeps looking at her all through breakfast like she's a wizard.*

gate_1.text: *At the gate, Ploy has her arm linked through Elysia's and is telling Jane and Bow about the meme. Elysia laughs at all the right places.*

gate_2.text: *Then she feels it, the way she always does. Kay is somewhere behind her.*

gate_3.text: *She turns around. There he is, by the gate. Very still, looking at her like she's far away.*

gate_4.speaker: Elysia
gate_4.text: [worried] [softly, to herself] He looks so tired. Grey. Did he sleep at all?

gate_5.text: *She smiles and waves. Kay waves back a second too late, a little too stiff. Like a robot remembering how arms work.*

gate_7.speaker: Elysia
gate_7.text: [reassuring herself] No. He's just Kay. He's always like that at school.

gate_9.speaker: Ploy
gate_9.text: [impatient] [whiny] "Elysia, focus, I'm getting to the part with the meme."

gate_10.text: *She mouths "later!" to Kay and lets herself get pulled away.*

line_1.text: *Lunch. She planned it. She'll admit that to herself, though never to anyone else.*

line_2.text: *She gets in the pad kra pao line right behind Kay and waits for him to notice. He doesn't. He's staring at the menu board like it's homework.*

line_4.text: *He turns around so fast he nearly drops his tray.*

line_5.speaker: Elysia
line_5.text: [teasing] "Pad kra pao again? You're so predictable."

line_6.speaker: Kay
line_6.text: [flustered] [stammering] "Y-you're one to talk. You're in the same line."

line_7.speaker: Elysia
line_7.text: [playful] [flirty] "Mm. And why do you think I'm in this line?"

line_8.text: *She watches him think about it. She can see him get there, and then back away from it, the way he backs away from everything.*

line_13.speaker: Elysia
line_13.text: [pouting] [half-serious] "You know, I always have to come find you. You never come find me."

line_14.speaker: Kay
line_14.text: [shy] [awkward] "I didn't want to bother you. You're always with your friends."

line_15.speaker: Elysia
line_15.text: [hurt] [to herself] "Always with your friends." Why does that sound like "always somewhere I'm not allowed"?

line_17.speaker: Lunch Lady
line_17.text: [dry] [unimpressed] "Are you two ordering, or just flirting?"

line_18.text: *She laughs. Kay goes red to his ears.*

line_19.speaker: Elysia
line_19.text: [warm] [hopeful] "Come sit with us if you want, okay?"

line_20.text: *She carries her tray back to the table by the window, glancing over her shoulder once.*

line_21.text: *Check: Ploy, eyebrows up. Jane, grinning. Bow, phone.*

line_23.speaker: Kay
line_23.text: [shy] [nervous] "Hey. Is it okay if I sit here?"

line_25.text: *The table goes silent. Ploy looks at Kay. Then at Elysia. Then at Kay again.*

line_27.speaker: Elysia
line_27.text: [embarrassed] [scolding] "Hey. Stop staring at him. Eat your food."

line_28.text: *Her face is hot. She's pouting, but not because she's upset. She's so happy she could scream.*

line_29.speaker: Elysia
line_29.text: [giddy] [softly, to herself] He came over. He actually came over. In front of everyone.

line_30.text: *Under the table, she bumps his foot with hers. Just once.*

line_31.text: *When Kay leaves to return his tray, Ploy leans in.*

line_32.speaker: Ploy
line_32.text: [gossipy] [judgmental] "So that's the boyfriend. He's cute. He's just... so quiet. Kind of weird?"

line_33.text: *"Weird" lands somewhere old in her chest. The third-grade place.*

line_34.text: *Check: Ploy, smiling, not mean. Jane, nodding. Bow, waiting for my answer.*

shy_3.text: *Everybody nods. The moment passes, smooth as water.*

shy_4.text: *Under the smile, a small voice says you should have said something. She smiles over it until it's quiet.*

notweird_1.text: *It comes out sharper than she meant. Ploy's eyebrows go up.*

notweird_2.speaker: Ploy
notweird_2.text: [defensive] [dismissive] "Okay, defensive. I didn't mean it bad."

notweird_3.speaker: Elysia
notweird_3.text: [backpedaling] [quickly] "I know! I know. Sorry. He's just quiet. That's all."
notweird_3.real_text: "No, I meant it. He's not weird."

notweird_4.text: *Ploy changes the subject. Elysia's heart is still beating too fast ten minutes later.*

walk_1.text: *After school. Kay is halfway through the gate.*

walk_2.speaker: Elysia
walk_2.text: [determined] [to herself] Do it. You're allowed to walk home with your own boyfriend.

walk_4.text: *Loud and bright, so it sounds easy. Behind her, Ploy whispers something to Jane. Elysia doesn't hear what. She hears the whisper.*

walk_5.text: *Kay looks at her. Then past her, at her friends. His face does something careful.*

walk_6.speaker: Kay
walk_6.text: [awkward] [apologetic] "I... shouldn't. You don't want people looking at us like that."

walk_7.text: *For half a second, something in her face drops. Like missing a step.*

walk_9.speaker: Elysia
walk_9.text: "[surprised] Oh! [forced brightness] Okay. That's fine! No worries."

walk_12.text: *She walks off alone. The smile stays on past the 7-Eleven, the bus stop, the corner. A beat too long. Then a hundred.*

walk_13.speaker: Elysia
walk_13.text: [hurt] [to herself] "You don't want people looking at us like that." Like what?

walk_14.speaker: Elysia
walk_14.text: [bitter] [hurt] Like the slime girl and the boy who has to stand next to her.

walk_15.text: *She knows it isn't fair. Kay is the gentlest person she knows.*

walk_16.speaker: Elysia
walk_16.text: [confused] [hurt] But he came to the table. And the second my friends were watching, he said no.

walk_17.speaker: Elysia
walk_17.text: [sad] [voice breaking] He's embarrassed of me. Like everyone. Like third grade.

walk_18.text: *6:30. Mint calls. Mint has called on Mondays since they were six.*

walk_19.speaker: Mint
walk_19.text: [curious] [deadpan] "So? Did you get him in the pad kra pao line?"

walk_20.speaker: Elysia
walk_20.text: [excited] [then uncertain] "I did! He sat with us. And then after school I asked him to walk home, and he said..."

walk_21.text: *She's on her bed, looking at the ceiling.*

walk_22.speaker: Elysia
walk_22.text: [hurt] [quietly] "He said he shouldn't. Because people would look at us."

mint_hurt_1.speaker: Elysia
mint_hurt_1.text: [sad] [honest] "It kind of hurt. Like he doesn't want people to know he's with me."

mint_hurt_2.speaker: Mint
mint_hurt_2.text: [deadpan] [serious] "Do you want me to fight him?"

mint_hurt_8.text: *It's what Mint says when she's already decided something. Elysia doesn't ask what. She should have.*

mint_fine_1.speaker: Elysia
mint_fine_1.text: [forced cheerful] "It's fine! He's just busy. He's always busy."

mint_fine_4.text: *Mint sighs the sigh of someone who has known you for eleven years and is choosing not to fight about it tonight.*

tue_1.text: *Tuesday. 6:20 a.m. She's been awake since five, typing.*

tue_2.text: *"why didn't you want to walk with me." Delete.*

tue_4.text: *"are you embarrassed of me." Delete. Delete. Delete.*

choices.text: "can i ask why you didn't want to walk yesterday?"

tue_cheer_1.speaker: Elysia
tue_cheer_1.text: [cheerful] [sing-song] goooood morning!! ☀️ did u eat breakfast

tue_cheer_2.text: *Like yesterday never happened. She's very good at that.*

tue_cheer_5.text: *She sends the sticker of the furious cat.*

tue_cheer_7.speaker: Elysia
tue_cheer_7.text: [forced calm] [to herself] He's fine. We're fine. Everything's normal.

tue_cheer_8.text: *She doesn't believe it. She puts the phone in her bag anyway.*

tue_ask_1.text: *She sends it before the version can stop her, and throws the phone onto the bed like it's hot.*

tue_ask_3.speaker: Kay
tue_ask_3.text: [apologetic] [quietly] sorry about yesterday. i didn't mean it like that.

tue_ask_4.speaker: Elysia
tue_ask_4.text: [hurt] [to herself] Like what? What did you mean?

tue_ask_6.text: *She looks at it. Then, before she can stop herself:*

tue_ask_8.text: *The typing dots appear and vanish three times.*

tue_ask_10.text: *He didn't explain. But he said sorry, and he didn't say "it's fine." She holds onto that.*

shop_1.text: *Thursday. Tutoring lets out at eight. The tutoring center is one street over from Kay's. She knows that. She has never once let herself think about it on purpose.*

shop_3.text: *Pun has sent it four times. So she goes into the 7-Eleven at the end of Kay's street.*

shop_4.text: *He's there. In a T-shirt, in front of the hot food case, holding one ham and cheese toastie and staring at a second one like it's a hard question on a test.*

shop_5.text: *Check: nobody from school. Nobody. Just the guy at the counter, watching a drama on his phone.*

shop_7.text: *He turns around, and for a second his face is completely open. Surprised. Happy? Then he looks at her basket.*

shop_8.speaker: Elysia
shop_8.text: [dramatic] [playful] "Tutoring's on the next street. Pun wants shrimp crackers. It's an emergency."

shop_13.speaker: Kay
shop_13.text: [teasing] "And the third one's an emergency too?"

shop_16.speaker: Elysia
shop_16.text: [surprised] [delighted, to herself] He's teasing me. Kay, who could barely lift his hand at the gate on Monday, is teasing me in a 7-Eleven.

shop_17.speaker: Kay
shop_17.text: [teasing] "Like the pad kra pao line. That was an emergency too?"

shop_coin_2.speaker: Kay
shop_coin_2.text: [teasing] [deadpan] "It's been a coincidence every Monday for two months."

shop_hit_2.text: *She hits his arm with her tutoring folder.*

shop_hit_3.speaker: Elysia
shop_hit_3.text: [flustered] [bossy] "I'm putting a yogurt drink in your basket. As a punishment."

shop_out_1.text: *Outside, she looks at his one toastie, then at him.*

shop_out_5.text: *She doesn't say anything. She just puts it somewhere, carefully, the way she keeps things she might need later.*

shop_out_7.speaker: Elysia
shop_out_7.text: [realizing] [hurt] Here. On a dark street, a hundred meters, where nobody can see.

choices.text: Ask him: "Why here? But not on Monday?"

shop_ask_2.text: *He goes quiet for a few steps.*

shop_ask_5.text: *The bus comes before she can ask.*

shop_quiet_1.text: *They walk very slowly. She eats one of Pun's shrimp crackers and offers him one, and he takes it. Their hands bump, twice. The second time, neither of them moves away.*

shop_quiet_2.text: *At the stop she looks at him a second too long. The question is right there. Why here, and not Monday? She doesn't ask. The bus comes.*

shop_bus_3.text: *The doors close. Her face is on fire. She sits by the window and watches him get smaller.*

shop_bus_4.speaker: Elysia
shop_bus_4.text: [sad] [to herself] So he can walk with me. Just not where anyone can see.

shop_bus_5.speaker: Elysia
shop_bus_5.text: [sad] [bitter] So it is them. It's them he's hiding me from.

garden_1.text: *The second week, Ploy plans a mall trip for Wednesday.*

garden_3.speaker: Elysia
garden_3.text: [apologetic] [lying] "I can't, I have to help my brother with a thing."

garden_4.text: *It's a lie. She's never lied to Ploy about plans before. But Kay has been at the school garden every afternoon. She's seen him from the art room window. Alone, holding the hose.*

garden_5.text: *Four beds behind the science building. Tiny seedlings. Very, very wet soil.*

garden_6.text: *Kay looks up and sees her. For a second his face is unguarded. Surprised. Happy?*

garden_9.speaker: Elysia
garden_9.text: [too bright] [nervous] "Hi! I was in the area."

garden_10.speaker: Kay
garden_10.text: [deadpan] [amused] "You were in the area. Behind the science building."

garden_12.text: *She crouches by the chili bed so he can't see her face. And then she sees it.*

garden_13.text: *On the old log edging the bed, where the soil is wettest: something bright yellow, spread across the bark. Like spilled egg yolk, branching into veins like a tiny map.*

garden_15.speaker: Elysia
garden_15.text: "[gasps] Oh. Oh! [excited whisper] Kay. Come here. Don't move fast."

garden_16.speaker: Elysia
garden_16.text: [excited] [rapid] [nerdy] "That's a slime mold. Physarum, I think. It's not a mold, it's not a plant, it's not an animal, it doesn't even have a brain, and it can still solve a maze. Scientists put oat flakes down in the shape of the cities around Tokyo, and it grew a network that looked almost exactly like the real train lines—"

garden_18.text: *She stops in the middle of the sentence and glances over her shoulder at the path.*

garden_20.speaker: Elysia
garden_20.text: "[catches herself] Sorry. [embarrassed] [quietly] That's weird. Nobody cares about slime."

garden_21.text: *Kay is looking at her. Not at the slime mold. At her.*

garden_24.text: *Check: his face. Not polite. Not pity. It's...*

garden_25.text: *She doesn't have a word for it. Nobody but Mint has ever looked at her like that while she was being slime girl.*

garden_maze.speaker: Elysia
garden_maze.text: [excited] [eager] "Okay. Watch. You put food down, and it finds it. Every single time."

garden_go_1.text: *Slowly at first, testing the ice. Then faster, because he keeps nodding and asking questions. How does it know where to go without a brain? Can it hurt you?*

garden_go_2.text: *Pink slime molds. Slime molds that crawl a few centimeters an hour. The one she kept in her lunchbox in third grade that found its way out of a paper maze overnight.*

garden_go_3.text: *For twenty minutes she doesn't check anyone's face once.*

garden_go_3b.text: *She checks the path twice. Nobody's there. Both times, Kay waits for her to come back.*

garden_go_4.text: *When she runs out of words, the sun is lower, and Kay is smiling at her.*

garden_tease_1.text: *She's still crouched by the log with her chin on her knees.*

garden_tease_4.speaker: Kay
garden_tease_4.text: [teasing] [deadpan] "Physarum. You've never looked at me like that."

garden_tease_5.speaker: Elysia
garden_tease_5.text: [surprised] [moved, to herself] He's teasing me about slime. Nobody teases me about slime. People laugh at me about slime.

garden_tease_6.text: *She waits for those to feel the same. They don't. They aren't even close.*

choices.text: Laugh it off: "Haha, it's just slime."

garden_tease_k_2.text: *She shoves his shoulder so hard he nearly sits in the chili bed. Her ears are burning.*

garden_tease_k_3.speaker: Elysia
garden_tease_k_3.text: [playful] [defensive] "It solved a maze. Without a brain. What have you ever solved?"

garden_tease_k_5.speaker: Elysia
garden_tease_k_5.text: "[laughs] That's not a maze. That's a hostage situation."

garden_tease_k_6.text: *He laughs. Really laughs, loud, with his head back. She has never heard him do that at school. She didn't know he could.*

garden_tease_k_7.speaker: Elysia
garden_tease_k_7.text: [giddy] [softly, to herself] I made Kay laugh. With slime.

garden_tease_off_3.text: *The laugh goes out of his face. She doesn't know why that feels like losing something.*

garden_stop_1.speaker: Elysia
garden_stop_1.text: "[forced laugh] Haha, anyway— [overly bright] wow, your chilies are so small! Is that normal?"

garden_stop_2.text: *Kay looks at her for a second like he's trying to work something out.*

garden_stop_4.text: *She doesn't look at the log again.*

garden_gate_1.text: *They walk to the gate. In the evening light, she looks at him properly for the first time in days.*

garden_gate_2.speaker: Elysia
garden_gate_2.text: [worried] [softly, to herself] Grey. He's grey, like a photo left in the sun.

garden_gate_6.text: *He laughs it off. She doesn't laugh.*

garden_gate_7.speaker: Elysia
garden_gate_7.text: [worried] [to herself] He's carrying something. He's always carrying something.

garden_gate_8.speaker: Elysia
garden_gate_8.text: [hopeful] [to herself] He'll tell me when he's ready.

vcall_1.text: *On Friday, Ploy calls until three. On Saturday night, Elysia video-calls Kay to do chemistry homework "together," which mostly means pointing her camera at her ceiling and groaning at question four.*

vcall_2.text: *At nine she props the phone up and squints at him. He looks pale in the screen light.*

vcall_7.speaker: Elysia
vcall_7.text: [exasperated] [bossy] "That's a drink. It's in the name. Go make eggs. I'm not hanging up until I hear the pan."

vcall_10.text: *She smiles into her hoodie sleeve so he won't see how much she likes it.*

vcall_12.text: *He makes two fried eggs with the phone balanced on the kettle. She supervises. The second one is structurally a tragedy, and she tells him so. He eats it anyway.*

vcall_13.text: *Back on question four, she yawns so wide the camera shakes.*

vcall_15.text: *Check: his face. He's asking. He actually wants to know.*

vcall_little_1.speaker: Elysia
vcall_little_1.text: [tired] [dismissive] "...A little. Till three. Ploy stuff. It's fine."

vcall_baby_2.speaker: Kay
vcall_baby_2.text: [teasing] [skeptical] "You're very bossy about my sleep for someone who slept like a baby."

vcall_diff_4.text: *She says it like it's obvious. Then she hears herself and pulls her hood all the way over her face.*

vcall_sleep_1.text: *The last thing she remembers is question six. His pencil, scratching. The fridge hum on his end.*

vcall_sleep_2.speaker: Elysia
vcall_sleep_2.text: [sleepy] [content, to herself] I could fall asleep like this every night.

vcall_sleep_3.text: *And then she does. In the morning:*

vcall_am_1.speaker: Elysia
vcall_am_1.text: [embarrassed] [sleepy] did i fall asleep on u

vcall_am_7.speaker: Elysia
vcall_am_7.text: [suspicious] [indignant] also WHY are 6 and 7 done in my book

vcall_am_11.speaker: Elysia
vcall_am_11.text: [touched] [worried, to herself] He did my homework. Of course he did. At midnight, while I was asleep, like it was nothing.

vcall_am_13.text: *She sends the furious cat sticker, then another one, then a voice message of herself saying "don't do my homework" as sternly as she can.*

nam_1.text: *The third week. In art class, Nam's plush frog keychain falls off her bag and skids across the floor to Ploy's feet.*

nam_2.speaker: Ploy
nam_2.text: [mocking] [laughing] "Oh my god. Who brings a plushie to high school?"

nam_3.text: *Ploy holds it up by one leg. Jane laughs. Bow laughs.*

nam_4.text: *Nam's face goes very still. Elysia knows that face. She wore it for a whole week in third grade.*

nam_5.text: *Check: Ploy, laughing. Jane, laughing. Bow, laughing. Nam, frozen.*

nam_6.speaker: Elysia
nam_6.text: [conflicted] [to herself] If I laugh, it's over in a second. If I don't...

nam_laugh_1.text: *She laughs. It's easy. Her body knows how.*

nam_laugh_2.text: *Ploy tosses the frog back. Nam puts it in her pocket instead of back on her bag, and bends over her drawing.*

nam_laugh_3.text: *Elysia feels sick for the rest of the afternoon. She tells herself it's the cafeteria fish.*

nam_cute_2.text: *Check: Ploy, confused. Jane, looking at Ploy. Bow, looking at me.*

nam_cute_5.text: *Elysia gives Nam a small smile, just for her. Nam stares back, surprised. Then she hooks the frog back onto her bag, right where it was.*

joke_1.text: *After school she goes to the garden without texting first. It's the one place she doesn't have to do anything.*

joke_2.text: *Kay is holding the hose. He sees her and turns off the screaming tap.*

joke_3.text: *She doesn't crouch by the log. She sits on the edge of the basil bed with her bag still on her shoulder and pulls out a weed, then another. She can't think of anything to say. That has never happened to her before.*

joke_4.text: *Kay sits down next to her. She can feel him trying to work out what's wrong. Then she watches him decide to make her laugh.*

joke_5.speaker: Kay
joke_5.text: [teasing] [playful] "Careful. Next you'll be keeping slime in your bag."

joke_7.text: *A rotten log. A boy's hands. The inside of her bag, slick and yellow. A whole week of laughing.*

joke_8.speaker: Elysia
joke_8.text: [hurt] [rationalizing] He doesn't know. He can't know. It's a joke about the version of me he likes. It's a nice joke.

joke_fine_1.text: *The laugh comes out by itself. The cafeteria one. The bright one.*

joke_fine_3.speaker: Elysia
joke_fine_3.text: [dismayed] [to herself] Oh no. I'm doing the version. With Kay.

joke_fine_4.text: *Kay looks at her for a long time.*

joke_fine_7.text: *She bumps his shoulder with hers, because she has to do something.*

joke_fine_9.text: *She stays ten more minutes. She doesn't talk about slime molds. When she leaves, she waves from the path and doesn't look back, because if she looks back he'll see her face.*

joke_hurt_2.text: *It comes out small. Kay's face goes stricken.*

joke_hurt_8.text: *He doesn't push. He turns the tap back on, very low, so there's a sound in the garden that isn't either of them.*

joke_text_1.text: *On Friday, Kay sends her a picture: tiny green hooks coming up out of the soil. Water spinach, he writes.*

joke_text_4.text: *It's the most normal thing she can think of. It means we're okay. It means I'm okay. It means keep sending me things.*

pun_1.text: *The fourth week. Pun comes home from school and doesn't go to his jar. He sits at the kitchen table with his backpack still on.*

pun_4.text: *Check: shoulders up. Mouth tight. He's eight. He's terrible at this.*

pun_6.speaker: Pun
pun_6.text: [sad] [voice breaking] [crying] "...They call me slime boy. I took my slime mold for show-and-tell and Tee smeared it all over the inside of my bag. Everyone laughed."

pun_8.speaker: Elysia
pun_8.text: [pained] [to herself] Third grade. Slime in my bag. A whole week.

pun_9.speaker: Elysia
pun_9.text: [protective] [determined] He's going to go through what I went through. Unless he learns what I learned.

pun_10.text: *She knows exactly what she learned. She could teach it to him in one sentence.*

choices.text: "Maybe... keep the slime at home? Just at school. Just for a while."
"Then be slime boy. Slime boy is the best kind of boy."

pun_hide_1.text: *Pun looks at her for a long time.*

sports_1.text: *Friday. Sports day. Her class team is red, and she's on the cheer squad. She shouts until her voice goes. The version is very good at sports day.*

mid_1.text: *The fifth week. Midterms. Ploy and her boyfriend break up on Monday.*

mid_2.text: *Ploy calls Monday night. Tuesday night. Wednesday night. Elysia answers every time and listens until two, three, four. She studies chemistry in the gaps.*

study_9.text: *Somewhere around card twenty, his answers get slower. Then they stop. His head lands on her shoulder.*

dinner_door_7.text: [curious] [moved, to herself] Why does he say it like he knows?
